title: Sebastian and the Witness
author: Tamsin Coldharbour
blurb: Bram Quintana, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
